# NetPayScale UK (NHS Edition)
# Keep in sync with /robots.txt and /ai.txt

> Official 2026/27 UK NHS Salary & Pension Calculator for 1.3M+ Agenda for Change healthcare staff. Computes net take-home pay, 3.3% AfC pay steps, London Weighting (HCAS), NHS 2015 CARE Pension tiers, Section 2 unsocial hours, Maternity Pay (OMP/SMP), Sick Pay, and Annual Leave.

NetPayScale UK is an open-access statutory payroll reference and calculator suite for UK National Health Service (NHS) staff employed under the Agenda for Change (AfC) framework. All figures reflect the confirmed 2026/27 tax year (effective 1 April 2026), including the 3.3% AfC consolidated pay uplift, HMRC PAYE Income Tax (England/Wales/NI and Scottish 6-band regimes), Class 1 National Insurance (8% / 2%), 2015 CARE NHS Pension tiers (5.2% to 12.5%), and High Cost Area Supplements (Inner London 20%, Outer London 15%, Fringe 5%). Contact: editorial@netpayscale.uk.

## Core Calculators (Markdown Twins)
- [NetPayScale UK — 2026/27 NHS Salary & Pension Calculator](https://netpayscale.uk/index.md): 2026/27 NHS Agenda for Change Band 2 to Band 9 salary tables, net monthly take-home pay, London Weighting (HCAS), and pension tiers.
- [NHS Pension Calculator 2026/27 (2015 CARE Scheme)](https://netpayscale.uk/pension-calculator.md): 7-tier NHS employee contribution rates (5.2%–12.5%), 23.7% employer contribution, Net-Pay tax relief, and 1/54th annual pension accrual.
- [NHS Sick Pay & Half-Pay Calculator 2026/27 (Section 14)](https://netpayscale.uk/sick-pay-calculator.md): NHS Occupational Sick Pay entitlements by years of service (1 to 6 months Full Pay + 2 to 6 months Half Pay) and Statutory Sick Pay (£118.75/wk).
- [NHS Maternity Pay Calculator 2026/27 (OMP + SMP Section 15)](https://netpayscale.uk/maternity-pay-calculator.md): 52-week NHS Occupational Maternity Pay timeline (8 wks 100%, 18 wks 50% + SMP £187.18/wk, 13 wks SMP, 13 wks unpaid), equal spread, and leave accrual.
- [NHS Annual Leave & Pro-Rata Holiday Calculator 2026/27 (Section 13)](https://netpayscale.uk/annual-leave-calculator.md): 27, 29, and 33 days NHS annual leave plus 8 public bank holidays converted into exact hours and shifts for full-time and part-time contracts.
- [NHS Bank Shift, Overtime & Section 2 Unsocial Hours Calculator 2026/27](https://netpayscale.uk/bank-shift-calculator.md): Section 2 unsocial hours multipliers (+44%/+88% Bands 2–3, +30%/+60% Bands 4–9), 1.5x overtime, +12.07% WTD holiday uplift, and net shift pay.
- [NHS Back Pay & 3.3% Pay Rise Arrears Calculator 2026/27](https://netpayscale.uk/pay-rise-backpay-calculator.md): Backdated 2026/27 NHS 3.3% Agenda for Change pay award arrears from 1 April after PAYE tax, 8% NICs, NHS Pension, and Student Loan.
- [NHS Band Promotion & Spine Step Net Pay Comparator 2026/27](https://netpayscale.uk/promotion-calculator.md): Side-by-side net monthly pay comparison across any two NHS Bands or spine steps, factoring in NHS Pension tier cliffs and unsocial shift changes.
- [NHS Redundancy & MARS Severance Calculator 2026/27 (Section 16)](https://netpayscale.uk/redundancy-pay-calculator.md): NHS Section 16 contractual redundancy (1 month per year up to 24 years, £80k salary cap), MARS severance, and £30,000 HMRC tax-free exemption.

## Popular Role & Regional Salary Benchmarks (HTML)

- [Band 6 Senior Paramedic Salary — Scotland](https://netpayscale.uk/calculator/band-6-senior-paramedic-salary-scotland/): £38,619 to £46,580 gross under Scottish 6-band Income Tax
- [Band 7 Clinical Manager Salary — Manchester](https://netpayscale.uk/calculator/band-7-clinical-manager-salary-manchester/): £47,810 to £54,710 gross (£2,855 to £3,190/mo net take-home)
- [Band 8a Matron Salary — Inner London](https://netpayscale.uk/calculator/band-8a-matron-salary-inner-london/): £55,690 base + £8,746 HCAS = £64,436 gross
